methods.name: get
methods.summary: Gets the current status of an asynchronous operation on a list.
methods.description:
Gets the current status of an asynchronous operation on a list.

The `status` property can have one of the following values: `pending`,
`running`, `completed`, or `failed`. If the status is `failed`, the `error`
property will contain a message describing the error.

props.name: account_id
props.description: The Account ID for this resource.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Appends new items to the list.
methods.description:
Appends new items to the list.

This operation is asynchronous. To get current the operation status, invoke the
`Get bulk operation status` endpoint with the returned `operation_id`.

There is a limit of 1 pending bulk operation per account. If an outstanding bulk
operation is in progress, the request will be rejected.

props.description: The Account ID for this resource.

props.name: redirect
props.description: The definition of the redirect.

props.name: hostname
props.description:
Hostnames support ASCII(7) letters from a to z, the digits from 0 to 9,
wildcards (\*), and the hyphen (-).

props.name: asn
props.description: Defines a non-negative 32 bit integer.

props.name: per_page
props.description:
Amount of results to include in each paginated response. A
non-negative 32 bit integer.

props.name: search
props.description:
A search query to filter returned items. Its meaning depends on the
list type: IP addresses must start with the provided string, hostnames and bulk
redirects must contain the string, and ASNs must match the string exactly.
